card.description: A colossal obsidian core engine, the heart of a subterranean temple, rises from a stone floor carved with Ethiopian and Egyptian motifs. Its cylindrical body is etched with intricate hieroglyphic glyphs that glow in bio‑luminescent blue, while a crystalline lattice of translucent quartz spirals upward, radiating pulsing energy. The engine’s surface is a tactile, reflective obsidian that catches the low, cinematic light, casting deep shadows across the ancient stone columns that surround it. This fusion of ancient craftsmanship and incomprehensible technology embodies industrial mysticism and grounded realism.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Massive obsidian cylinder, 12m tall, etched with hieroglyphic glyphs, crystalline lattice spirals
**Face/Sensors:** Glowing bio‑luminescent glyphs, crystalline nodes pulsing with energy
**Key Features:** Reflective obsidian surface, crystalline lattice, pulsing energy core, stone columns with Ethiopian/Egyptian motifs
evolution: Phase 1 (Activation): Glyphs glow faintly, crystalline lattice emits a soft hum
Phase 2 (Full Power): Glyphs blaze, lattice pulses with intense energy, engine hums loudly
props: Item: Scepter of Light – a bronze staff with a crystal tip emitting a steady glow
Item: Runic Tablet – a stone tablet inscribed with combined Ethiopian and Egyptian runes
